name: Article 1, § 1, point 17; Regulation (EU) 2023/956 – Article 27 a – 122
title: REPORT on the proposal for a regulation of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Regulation (EU) 2023/956 as regards the extension of its scope to downstream goods and anti-circumvention measures
part_text: 17a. Article 27a is replaced by the following: ‘Article 27a Serious and unforeseen circumstances 1. The Commission shall carry out continuous monitoring of the impacts of the CBAM on the internal market, the competitiveness of industry, investments, industrial production, exports, consumer prices and security of supply. 2. In response to a duly reasoned request by a Member State, the Commission shall examine whether the requirements of paragraph 3 have been met. It shall issue to the requesting Member State a decision, including a statement of reasons, no later than four weeks after receipt of the request. 3. If, taking into account the available evidence, the Commission considers that the inclusion of a good in Annex I would have significant negative effects on the internal market due to serious or unforeseen circumstances or would significantly jeopardise industrial competitiveness, investments, production, exportability or security of supply in one or more Member States, it shall adopt a delegated act pursuant to Article 28 with a view to removing this good from Annex I on a temporary basis. The removal shall remain in force until the relevant circumstances no longer apply.’
